meta.title: fix: Prefetch cache grows indefinitely
meta.body_summary: Fix unbounded growth of the prefetch cache by cleaning up expired items when prefetching objects.

core_change_summary.description: In DataBrowser.react.js, added cleanup of stale entries in the prefetch cache by periodically removing expired items to prevent infinite growth. Other commits temporarily modified info panel loading behavior but were reverted; the final change is a small adjustment to cache handling.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Info panel changes in commits 5f9f046 and e8c79ee were added then reverted; they may have been part of the fix iteration but ultimately removed.
